question: The average of 21 numbers is 74. The average of the first 11 numbers is 72.8 and that of the last 11 numbers is 77.2. If the 10th number is five less than the 11th number and if 10th and 11th numbers are excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers? (correct to nearest integer)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

11th number = Average + 11 × (Deviation of first 11) + 11 × (Deviation of last 11)

11th number = 74 + 11 × (72.8 − 74) + 11 × (77.2 − 74) = 74 + 22 = 96

10th number = 96 − 5 = 91

Total deviation of 10th and 11th numbers from average = (96 − 74) + (91 − 74) = +39

Since the excluded numbers are 39 above average, the average of the remaining 19 numbers will decrease.

New average = 74 − (39 ÷ 19) = 74 − 2.05 = 71.95 ≈ 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total numbers = 21, Average = 74

Average of first 11 numbers = 72.8

Average of last 11 numbers = 77.2

 
 
 First 11: 11 × 72.8 = 800.8

 
 
 Last 11: 11 × 77.2 = 849.2

 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 Total 21 Numbers: 21 × 74 = 1554

 
 
 
 

 
 10th = 91
 
• 

 11th = 96
 
• 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of all 21 numbers = 21 × 74 = 1554

⇒ Sum of first 11 numbers = 11 × 72.8 = 800.8

⇒ Sum of last 11 numbers = 11 × 77.2 = 849.2

⇒ By adding the first 11 and last 11, the 11th number is counted twice.

⇒ 11th number = (800.8 + 849.2) − 1554

⇒ 11th number = 1650 − 1554 = 96

⇒ 10th number = 96 − 5 = 91

⇒ Sum of excluded numbers (10th and 11th) = 96 + 91 = 187

⇒ Sum of remaining 19 numbers = 1554 − 187 = 1367

⇒ Average of remaining 19 numbers = 1367 ÷ 19 = 71.947 ≈ 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Overlapping Concept in Averages

When a sequence is divided into two overlapping parts, the common item is counted twice. It can be isolated using: Overlapping Item = (Sum of Part 1 + Sum of Part 2) − Total Sum.

Impact of Excluded Items

If the values removed from a group are greater than the original average, the new average of the remaining items will decrease. Change in average = Total deviation of removed items ÷ Remaining number of items.

Combined Average

When groups are combined, the new average is given by A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the number of items and A is their respective average.
